title: over the vale
summary: Ride a dragon wherever you like over a river valley: under a stone aqueduct, round floating islands, out to sea, from midday into dusk.
medium: flyable 3d scene, three.js, custom shaders on stock materials, single file

specs.controls: click, mouse to look, WASD to fly, space up, C down, shift faster, T day / dusk
specs.water: the whole world is drawn a second time, upside down, and mirrored in the river and sea
specs.grass: 150,000 blades in one patch that follows the camera
specs.inspired by: "a painted 3D world" by @LexnLin on X; the world, the dragon and the code are new
